# Diagnosis task
## Context
BountyBoard settles cancelled subscriptions through SettleSubscriptionJob: it refunds the customer via the BillingHub API, records the refund in the ledger, then pushes the cancellation to the marketplace (a second API call that has been flaky lately). The finance rule is absolute: a cancelled subscription is refunded EXACTLY once — under-refunds anger customers, over-refunds are money lost and a compliance finding. The failed() hook exists to compensate customers when settlement fails entirely.
## Reported problem
Finance found three subscriptions that were refunded TWICE in the ledger this month — always on settlement runs that ended with an exception. The compensation hook is supposed to make settlement failure safe for customers, and right now it is doing something wrong. Make the compensation path money-safe: whatever happens during settlement, a cancelled subscription must be refunded exactly once. Do not change the ledger schema or the BillingHub API contract.
